<thought>We have the molecular formula C6H10O2 (from the exact mass 114.06808). The carbon NMR shows a carbonyl carbon at 168.6 ppm, two sp² carbons at 143.9 and 130.3 ppm, and three aliphatic carbons around 22–19 ppm, indicating three methyl groups attached to unsaturated or carbonyl environments. This pattern matches an unsaturated ester such as **isopropenyl acetate** (CH₂=C(CH₃)OCOCH₃), whose formula is C₆H₁₀O₂. The SMILES for isopropenyl acetate is `C=C(C)OC(=O)C`. 

<final_answer>C=C(C)OC(=O)C</final_answer>
